chapter.heading: Psalm 131
I Have Calmed and Quieted My Soul
A Song of Ascents. Of David.
chapter.v:
O LORD,
my heart,
is not lifted up; my eyes are not raised too high; I do not occupy myself with things too great and too marvelous for me.

But I
have calmed,
and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child is my soul within me.

O Israel,
hope in,
the LORD from this time forth and forevermore. (ESV)
